name: band-mcp
description: Unofficial BAND (band.us) tools for Claude — bands, posts, comments, events, members and chats via your signed-in browser

band_ws_port.title: Bridge port
band_ws_port.description: The fetchproxy bridge port. The whole fetchproxy fleet and ContextMint Bridge share `37149`; override only for local testing (or when a host injects a per-registration port). Defaults to 37149.

user_tz.title: Time zone (optional)
user_tz.description: Optional. Your IANA time zone, for example America/New_York. It is sent to BAND as the device time zone and used for "today" in band_list_events. Leave blank to use the system zone.

confirm_mode.title: Write confirmation mode (optional)
confirm_mode.description: Optional. What band_create_post and band_create_comment do on a client that cannot show a confirmation prompt: "ask-user" (default: the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and the model must get your approval in chat before using it), "auto" (the model may use the token after reviewing the preview itself) or "refuse". An unrecognised value is treated as refuse. Leave blank for the default.

confirm_elicitation.title: Confirmation prompts (optional)
confirm_elicitation.description: Optional. "off" never shows a confirmation prompt, so every client gets the confirmation-mode flow. Set it for a client that says it can show prompts but never does. Defaults to on. Leave blank for the default.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Log the browser bridge role and lifecycle to stderr. Diagnostic only; off by default.

tools.name: band_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the BAND session: whether the browser session is readable, minutes until it expires, and whether BAND's API accepts it.

tools.name: band_whats_new
tools.description: Counts of new feed posts, unread chat messages and news across all your bands.

tools.name: band_list_bands
tools.description: List the bands (groups) you belong to, with their number, name and member count.

tools.name: band_get_band
tools.description: One band's details: type, open/secret, member count, leader, link, chat on/off.

tools.name: band_list_members
tools.description: List a band's members with role, online state and join date; optional name filter.

tools.name: band_list_posts
tools.description: Read a band's feed — posts and announcements — newest first, with paging.

tools.name: band_get_post
tools.description: Read one post in full, with its comments by default.

tools.name: band_list_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one post, with paging.

tools.name: band_list_notices
tools.description: List a band's notices (posts pinned as important).

tools.name: band_search_posts
tools.description: Search a band's posts by keyword.

tools.name: band_list_events
tools.description: List a band's calendar events between two dates (default the next 60 days).

tools.name: band_list_chats
tools.description: List a band's chat channels with unread counts and latest message.

tools.name: band_get_chat
tools.description: Read one chat channel: participants, unread state and latest message (no history).

tools.name: band_create_post
tools.description: Write a new post to a band (confirm-gated: preview first, then post).

tools.name: band_create_comment
tools.description: Comment on a band post (confirm-gated: preview first, then comment).
